title: MuleSoft APIkit console is exposed
summary: A MuleSoft APIkit application is serving its auto-generated API Console to anyone. The console publishes the whole API definition, every resource, method, parameter and schema, and lets a visitor call the API from the browser. It is meant for development and should be off in production.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known and the console page is told apart from a soft 404.
confirm.differential: status == 200 and "text/html" in header("content-type") and body_contains("api-console-app") and body_differs(control)

reproduce: curl -sk 'https://host/console/' and look for the MuleSoft API Console page: an HTTP 200 HTML response whose body carries the api-console-app element that boots the console. If present, the full API definition is published and callable. Try /console, /api/console/, /api-console/ as well, since the console path is set per application.
remediate: Turn the APIkit console off in production: set the system property apikit.console.disabled=true, or remove the console flow from the application, and block the console path at the gateway. Keep it to non-production environments.
